Canoe.headline: One trip, one budget, paid on-chain.
Canoe.intro: Set a budget for flights, hotels and car rental. Every payment needs your OK in your wallet, and a payment over budget is refused automatically.
Canoe.demoNote: Demo mode: this uses free NEAR test tokens with no real value. Bookings are simulated. Payments are {percent}% of the real price so test balances last.
Canoe.step1Body: Your wallet keeps your NEAR. CANOE never sees your keys.
Canoe.walletHelp1: Create a free Meteor Wallet and pick a testnet account.
Canoe.walletHelp2: Get free test NEAR for that account.
Canoe.walletHelp3: Come back here and tap Connect wallet.
Canoe.budgetSummary: You'll set aside {near} NEAR from your wallet (demo price for {usd}). Unused money comes back when you end the trip.
Canoe.rateError: Can't load the NEAR price right now. Try again in a minute.
Canoe.lastTrip: Your last trip budget has ended. Unused money went back to your wallet.
Canoe.noOffers: No tracked offers with a price yet. Track a flight, hotel or car first.
Canoe.overBudget: More than what's left in your {category} budget — the contract will refuse it.
Canoe.howItWorks: Your wallet asks you to approve the payment. The budget rules are checked by a NEAR smart contract, not by this website. Money only moves if the payment fits what's left in that budget.
Canoe.working: Check your wallet window and tap Approve.

errors.overLimit: This costs more than what's left in your {category} budget. Nothing was paid.
errors.quoteExpired: This price expired. Tap Pay again to get a fresh price.
errors.tripExpired: This trip budget has ended. Return the unused money and set a new budget.
errors.tripClosed: This trip budget is already closed.
errors.alreadyPaid: You already paid for this offer.
errors.notOwner: Only the wallet that created this budget can use it.
errors.budgetInvalid: Your budget couldn't be saved. Check the amounts and try again.
errors.cancelled: You cancelled in your wallet. Nothing was paid.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was paid. (Details: {details})
